name: Freila (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Freila (a castle on red above a tree).
history: Freila adopted its arms and flag officially on 8 October 1996; the flag is rectangular, divided into two equal stripes perpendicular to the staff, yellow above and blue below, with the arms centred and superimposed.

features.role: Freila arms — castle above a tree
